title: Ditto Connect partner onboarding basics
description: A short check that new Ditto Connect partners understand the fundamentals of identity verification before they start referring customers.

questions.prompt: Which Ditto product verifies that a government-issued ID document is genuine?
questions.explanation: Ditto Verify checks that a document is genuine and matches the person presenting it. Authenticate handles ongoing sign-in, Protect covers fraud and risk signals, Intelligence is the shared data layer underneath all three.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are things you should tell a prospective customer about Ditto during a first conversation? Select all that apply.

options.label: Ditto supports document and biometric verification
Ditto guarantees zero fraud for any customer that signs up
Ditto covers Verify, Authenticate, Protect and ID under one platform
Onboarding typically starts with a scoping call, not a contract

questions.explanation: Never promise a guarantee we can't back — "zero fraud" isn't a claim we make. The other three are accurate and safe to lead with.

questions.prompt: A partner can share their own Ditto login credentials with a customer so the customer can test the platform.
questions.explanation: Credentials are never shared between accounts — set the customer up with their own sandbox access instead.

questions.prompt: In your own words, what's the one-sentence pitch you'd give a customer for why they should use Ditto?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Ditto lets you verify who someone really is in seconds, not days.
